name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Watermelon Grape
description: Watermelon Grape tastes like two candy classics crashed into the same bag. Juicy watermelon starts light and refreshing before deep, rich grape rolls in with that unmistakable purple-candy punch. The whole combo gets covered in tiny, colorful crunchy candies, delivering a crackly first bite before revealing two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy underneath.
